terms.definition: A closed shape with three straight sides, three vertices, and three angles.
terms.whereItIs: The triangular plate on the board.
terms.whyItMatters: Triangles are the strongest and most common engineering shape.

terms.definition: A corner point where two sides of the triangle meet.
terms.function: Each of the three corners holds an interior angle.
terms.whyItMatters: Vertices are where angles are measured.

terms.definition: The property of holding its shape under pressure — cannot be pushed out of form.
terms.function: A triangle's sides lock its angles in place.
terms.whyItMatters: Rigidity makes triangles the backbone of bridges and roofs.

terms.definition: Triangle families by side lengths: all equal, two equal, none equal.
terms.function: Name the triangle from its sides at a glance.
terms.whereItIs: The preset labels on the board.
terms.whyItMatters: Side families help you describe and classify any triangle.
